Adapted from the [standalone Resource example](xcsh://terraform-documentation/documentation/resources/healthcheck/examples/resource/index.md?view=context#resource), using only your six resource values. Provider pinned to the reviewed bundled version, **v12.4.0**.

```hcl
terraform {
  required_version = ">= 1.0"

  required_providers {
    xcsh = {
      source  = "f5-sales-demo/xcsh"
      version = "= 12.4.0"
    }
  }
}

provider "xcsh" {}

resource "xcsh_healthcheck" "synthetic_probe" {
  name      = "synthetic-probe"
  namespace = "synthetic-lab"

  healthy_threshold   = 3
  interval            = 10
  timeout             = 3
  unhealthy_threshold = 2
}
```

### Supplied field constraints

All six fields are provider-schema **required**.

| Field | Documented constraints |
|---|---|
| [name](xcsh://terraform-documentation/documentation/resources/healthcheck/properties/index.md?view=context#schema-name) | String; `NameValidator`; unique within namespace. Upstream documents DNS-1035 naming, 1–63 characters. |
| [namespace](xcsh://terraform-documentation/documentation/resources/healthcheck/properties/index.md?view=context#schema-namespace) | String; `NamespaceValidator`. Upstream documents DNS-label naming, 1–63 characters. |
| [healthy_threshold](xcsh://terraform-documentation/documentation/resources/healthcheck/properties/index.md?view=context#schema-healthy_threshold) | Integer; provider-enforced inclusive range **1–16**. |
| [interval](xcsh://terraform-documentation/documentation/resources/healthcheck/properties/index.md?view=context#schema-interval) | Integer seconds; provider-enforced inclusive range **1–600**. |
| [timeout](xcsh://terraform-documentation/documentation/resources/healthcheck/properties/index.md?view=context#schema-timeout) | Integer seconds; provider-enforced inclusive range **1–600**. |
| [unhealthy_threshold](xcsh://terraform-documentation/documentation/resources/healthcheck/properties/index.md?view=context#schema-unhealthy_threshold) | Integer; provider-enforced inclusive range **1–16**. |

Upstream naming pattern: `^[a-z]([-a-z0-9]*[a-z0-9])?$`. Both supplied strings and all numeric values satisfy the documented constraints.

[Authentication](xcsh://terraform-documentation/documentation/provider/setup/index.md?view=full#authentication-options) remains environment-based: set `XCSH_API_URL` and exactly one supported token or certificate method.

Schema-reviewed only; `terraform validate`, plan, and apply were not run.
